name: layered-review
description: [skills] Code review in layers instead of one gate, for repos where agents write much of the code: risk tiers decided by the change (not the author), verification before the PR, parallel bug hunters by perspective with a separate vote to drop false positives, Important / Nit / Pre-existing labels, a round limit with diff-only re-review so agent loops converge, and an eval that replays missed bugs from incidents and reverts to score every change to the reviewer. A dependency-free checker runs the risk tier and scoring in CI
